THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0: I've returned. Give me everything you've got.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-1: Hmph... I'll humor you once more.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.2-0: The strength I've forged here — withstand it.
NEOW.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.ancient: ...A swordsman has arrived. Let me tend to your wounds.
NEOW.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.ancient: ...You climb the tower again. Your training never ends.
NEOW.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.2-0r.ancient: ...You return once more. Tireless as ever.
DARV.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.ancient: Oh! All those weapons... a true Weapon Master!
DARV.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.ancient: Welcome back! I've got great items for you today.
DARV.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.4-0r.ancient: You seem stronger every time... makes me a little nervous, honestly.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.an: Oho... a new face. Looking for something special?
NONUPEIPE.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.an: You're back. Take whatever catches your eye.
NONUPEIPE.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.4-0r.an: Your face is familiar now... I think I know what you want.
OROBAS.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.ancie: I wonder what weapons a Weapon Master carries.
OROBAS.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-1r.char: If it makes me stronger, I'll consider it.
OROBAS.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.ancie: You're back. What sort of trade do you have in mind?
OROBAS.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.4-0r.ancie: Dealings with you are always... interesting.
PAEL.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.ancient: First time here. What are you looking for, swordsman?
PAEL.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.ancient: You're back. Was the last one useful?
TANX.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.ancient: Oh! A new face! What do you need?
TANX.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.ancient: Back again! What are you taking this time?
TANX.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.4-0r.ancient: I think I know your taste by now. Let's see...
TEZCATARA.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.an: My, a new guest. Can I offer you something to eat?
TEZCATARA.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.an: You're back. I've already prepared something for you.
TEZCATARA.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.4-0r.an: There you are. You need to eat to fight.
VAKUU.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.0-0r.ancien: ...Ah, a swordsman. Speak if you need something.
VAKUU.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.1-0r.ancien: ...You're back. What do you want this time.
VAKUU.talk.SOLDOROS-SOLDOROS.4-0r.ancien: ...You keep coming. I can tell you're getting stronger.
